## The Five Parts

Over one semester, you build a complete content analysis from scratch — qualitative immersion through quantitative testing — using real media data.

| Part | Chapters | Focus |
|------|----------|-------|
| **I: Foundation** | 1–3 | Storytelling as science, open tools, epistemology |
| **II: Planning** | 4–6 | Literature, theory, the research prospectus |
| **III: Operationalization** | 7–9 | Qualitative immersion, codebook, data collection |
| **IV: Execution** | 10–12 | Sampling, data wrangling, visualization |
| **V: Inference and Publication** | 13–14 | Statistical inference, the one-click report |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## The Ecosystem

Three tools work together throughout the course. Each serves a distinct role.

| Tool | What It Does | When You Use It |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| [**Methods Vault**](methods-vault.qmd) | Obsidian workspace for journals, notes, and project files | Every week — your personal research archive |
| [**R Workbook**](workbook/index.qmd) | Hands-on R tutorials with narrated videos | Parts III–V — learning R for data analysis |
| [**Textbook**](https://aura-lab-siue.github.io/v2v/) | *Vibes to Variables* (3rd Edition, 14 chapters) | Every week — conceptual foundations for each part |
